title: PHP 8.4.19 Released!
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.4.19. This is a bug fix release.

All PHP 8.4 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 8.4.19 please visit our , Windows source and binaries can also be found . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagethereChangeLog
